title: shorts_candidates
description: Ranked Shorts candidates of an edit, written by scripts/shorts_rank.py: self-contained spans of 20-60 seconds inside one chapter that start on a sentence start and end on a sentence end, scored by the model on hook and payoff. The top candidates are the input of shorts_generator.py (--candidates) and the top 3 become Mango markers in the FilmCraft export. Times are timeline seconds of the edit they were ranked on.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the file was written

tool.description: the script that wrote the file, e.g. scripts/shorts_rank.py

start_s.description: timeline start in seconds, on a sentence start

end_s.description: timeline end in seconds, on a sentence end

hook.description: model score for how well the span opens a Short

payoff.description: model score for how well the span pays off

reason.description: one line on why this span works as a Short

chapter_start_s.description: timeline start of the chapter the span sits in, when chapters.json was given

chapter_title.description: title of that chapter, when chapters.json was given

layout.description: how shorts_generator.py builds the 9:16 frame: 'face' (default) is the reframe.py face crop; 'split' stacks the face region over the screen region of the same 16:9 frame
